Dave Matthews Band
November 13, 2021
Madison Square Garden - New York, NY

Taper: Zachary Semcken
Source: AKG C414 XLII (Hypercardioid) > Zoom F6 (32 Bit Float)
Location: Left of FOH, Sec E, Row 2, Seat 1, Mics DIN @ 12'
Editing: WAV > Reaper 6.41 (Gain, Mixing, Normalizing) > Audacity 3.1.1 (Fades, Tracking) > FLAC (Level 8)

Dave Matthews Band:

Dave Matthews - Guitar, Lead Vocals
Tim Reynolds - Electric Guitar
Stefan Lessard - Bass
Buddy Strong - Keyboards, Vocals
Rashawn Ross - Trumpet, Vocals
Ben Golder-Novick - Saxophone
Carter Beauford - Drums

Notes:

* with Nature intro
& with Stop Time intro
^ with Bourbons & Lacs and American Baby Intro interpolations

# with Alex Wasily (Trombone) and Ashlin Parker (Trumpet) of Dumpstaphunk
$ with Down by the Riverside interpolation
@ Sly & The Family Stone cover
! with prelude
? truncated version
€ with Carter solo intro, Shake Your Body (Down to the Ground) interpolation

Jeff Coffin was unable to perform due to a breakthrough case of COVID-19. Ben Golder-Novick filled in for the evening.

Huge thanks to the DMB Crew for letting me set up at FOH.

Thank you to Greg Mendelsohn for all his help during the show.

This recording is dedicated to all the tapers before me who continue to preserve live music.

Compiled on 2021/11/14.
